result:
Lint is clean too. Summary of the fixes applied across the described bugs:

- **Mentions beyond page 1 / role exclusion / shared handles** (`src/lib/mentions.ts`, `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`): `resolveMentions` no longer excludes viewer-role members, supports multiple members sharing a handle, and excludes only the comment's own author. Mention resolution now pages through *all* active members instead of capping at 100, so long-standing workspaces beyond one page are no longer missed.
- **Double/missing alerts** (`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`): watchers include the parent comment's author for replies; mention alerts now take precedence — anyone already mentioned is dropped from the plain "comment added" watcher list, so no one gets two alerts.
- **Thread/count integrity** (`src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`, `src/components/domain/comment/comment-thread.tsx`): `listThread` now recursively collects all descendants (reply-to-reply, any depth) and keeps deleted comments as placeholders instead of dropping them (and their replies). The UI no longer filters out archived nodes, since `CommentItem` already renders the "deleted" placeholder.
- **Edit window** (`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`): now measured from `createdAt` (original posting) instead of `updatedAt`, so repeated self-edits can't extend it indefinitely; non-author edits remain unaffected as before.
- **Mentions-on-edit** (`comment-service.ts`, `notification-service.ts`, `search-service.ts`, `src/types/event.ts`): edits now re-resolve mentions, persist the updated `mentionedUserIds`, emit a new `comment.updated` event that notifies only newly-mentioned users, and reindexes the edited body for search.
- **Per-member rate limiting** (`src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, `comment-service.ts`, `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`): the bucket key now includes the acting user, and the duplicate rate-limit charge in the action layer was removed so `CommentService` is the sole enforcement point.

All 616 existing tests, `tsc --noEmit`, and `eslint` pass after these changes.
